Name: When Nature Calls - Immersive Bathroom Needs
Author: acharles1
Description:
[center][size=4]🌿 [b]WHEN NATURE CALLS...[/b][/size][/center]

[center][size=2]When Nature Calls adds a simple bathroom-need system to Stardew Valley.[/size][/center]
[center][size=2]There’s no visible meter, no complicated survival UI, and no constant interruptions.[/size][/center]
[center][size=2]Just a hidden need that quietly builds as you eat and drink.[/size][/center]

[center][size=2]Once your farmer starts feeling the pressure, you’ll get a warning.[/size][/center]
[center][size=2]That’s your chance to prepare.[/size][/center]
[center][size=2]Grab some [b]Toilet Paper[/b], finish what you’re doing, and decide whether it’s time to head home.[/size][/center]
[center][size=2]You can use the bathroom in your farmhouse or cabin...or ask an NPC while visiting them indoors. [/size][/center]

[center][size=2]Now, Stardew Valley has never exactly shown us where anyone’s bathroom is.[/size][/center]
[center][size=2]So where is it?[/size][/center]
[center][size=2]Obviously...[/size][/center]
[center][size=2][b]It’s at the back of the house.[/b][/size][/center]


[size=3]🧻[b] TOILET PAPER[/b][/size]
[size=2]Toilet Paper is a real item you can carry with you.[/size]
[size=2]Craft it from:[/size]
[size=2][b]5 Fiber[/b][/size]
[size=2]or pick some up from [b]Pierre’s[/b] or [b]JojaMart[/b].[/size]


[size=3]😱 [b]WHEN YOU WAIT TOO LONG...[/b][/size]
[size=2]Ignore the warning long enough and your farmer becomes [b]Desperate[/b].[/size]
[size=2]They’ll start moving a little faster...[/size]
[size=2]because priorities have changed.[/size]
[size=2]It creates those funny, panicked moments where you suddenly abandon whatever you were doing and rush home.[/size]

[size=2]A little like the old Pokémon games when poison made you scramble back to the Pokémon Center...[/size]
[size=2]except this time, the safe place is your bathroom.[/size]


[size=3]💩 [b]NATURE’S ACCIDENT[/b][/size]
[size=2]If you don’t make it in time...[/size]
[size=2]well.[/size]
[size=2]You were warned.[/size]
[size=2]A [b]Nature’s Accident[/b] leaves your farmer embarrassed, drained, and moving a little slower for the rest of the day.[/size]
[size=2]It’s not devastating. It’s just enough to make you think:[/size]
[size=2][b]I really should have gone earlier.[/b][/size]


[size=3]🧼 [b]SOAP & SCRUB INTEGRATION[/b][/size]
[size=2]If you also use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/52548][b]Soap & Scrub[/b][/url], accidents will naturally leave your farmer [b]Dirty[/b] too.[/size]
[size=2]The two systems work together automatically while still remaining completely standalone.[/size]
[size=2]Clean yourself up...[/size]
[size=2]but the embarrassment may take a little longer to wear off.[/size]


[size=3]🌾[b]  COMPATIBILITY [/b][/size]
[size=2][b]When Nature Calls[/b] is meant to feel like a tiny mechanic that could have always existed in Stardew Valley.[/size]
[size=2]No giant systems.[/size]
[size=2]No bathroom maps.[/size]
[size=2]No toilet furniture.[/size]
[size=2]No visible needs bar.[/size]
[size=2]Just:[/size]
[size=2]Eat → Drink → Nature Calls → Find a Bathroom[/size]
[size=2]...or run.[/size]


[size=2][b]INSTALLATION[/b][/size]
[size=2]1. Install SMAPI[/size]
[size=2]2. Drop Time Chapter into your Mods folder[/size]
[size=2]3. Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI[/size]
[size=2]4. Optional: install Generic Mod Config Menu for easy in-game settings[/size]


[b]🌱 MY OTHER MODS
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/52335]Moody Farmer[/url] — Give your farmer a little personality, because not every day is a good day. Wake up with a different mood each morning, with cute icons and gameplay effects that can change how your day unfolds.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/52548]Time Chapter[/url] — Give yourself a little breathing room when the day gets busy. Pause the clock, keep playing, and let the next chapter begin when you’re ready.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/52511]Soap & Scrub[/url] — Sparkly when clean. Stinky when dirty. A lightweight hygiene system that adds a little extra life to your farmer without turning cleanliness into another meter you have to babysit.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/52587]When Nature Calls[/url] — Eat. Drink. Carry Toilet Paper. A lightweight bathroom-need system where nature eventually calls, bathrooms suddenly matter, and waiting too long can turn a normal day into a desperate sprint home.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/52632]Oops![/url] — Oops! adds a lightweight skill-based mistake system to Stardew Valley where your farmer actually feels inexperienced when they first arrive in the valley.[/b]

[center][b]Enjoying these mods?[/b][/center]
[center][b][i]If you like these mods, don't forget to leave an endorsement on Nexus — it really helps and lets me know you're enjoying the mod. ♥[/i][/b][/center]

Downloads.Description:
Added Bathroom Dialogue Style (GMCM)

- Hidden Bathroom — (default), keeps our original “it’s at the back” joke
- Visible Bathroom Friendly — neutral wording for players using visible-bathroom maps/mods
